name: Offers
description: Offers to acts, after Opendate's v3 offers: one act's deal for a show (flat, versus, plus or door, with bonuses, an expenses cap, merch and a deposit), on a budget that several offers can share (a lineup). Sending emails the agent a link to accept or decline without an account. Offers are drafts until sent; editing what the agent agreed to takes a sent offer back to draft. Webhooks: offer.sent, offer.accepted, offer.declined. Money is in cents. Opendate's /v3_offers paths answer too. Reads need `booking:read`, writes `booking:write`.

endpoints.description: Newest first. A sent offer past its expiry reads (and is saved) as expired.

parameters.name: hold_id
parameters.description: Only offers made from this hold.

parameters.name: budget_id
parameters.description: Only offers on this budget (a lineup).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-10000 (default 1). A page past the end answers an empty data array.

example.error: status must be one of draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired, cancelled.

endpoints.description: A draft offer to one act. From a template (template_id: its terms, boilerplate, budget lines and expiry) and/or a hold. A new budget is made unless budget_id joins an existing one; budget { name, capacity, average_price_cents, sell_through_percent, lines: [{ category_key | category_id, kind, label, amount_cents }] } sets it up. For a rented room with rental terms on the hold, a Venue rental line with the fee is added. Opendate's wrapped body ({ v3_offer: {...} }) works too.

parameters.name: artist_name
parameters.description: The act, 1-150 characters. Required on create unless artist_id (or the hold) names one.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Up to 150 characters (Opendate: event_name). Default: the hold title, else the act.

parameters.name: dates
parameters.description: Show dates, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 31. From a hold: its active nights.

parameters.name: hold_id
parameters.description: A hold to make the offer from (Opendate: calendar_event_id): its nights, venue, room, first artist and rental terms. Converting the hold links the offer to the new event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: The show, once there is one.

parameters.name: terms
parameters.description: Deal terms (all optional on a change, merged into the current terms): { deal_type: flat | versus | plus | door, guarantee_cents, percentage (0-100), expenses_cap_cents (or null), promoter_profit_percent (plus deals), bonuses: [{ sold, amount_cents }] (cumulative, at most 10), merch_artist_percent (or null), deposit_cents, deposit_due_on (YYYY-MM-DD), hospitality, rider }. Opendate spellings dollar_amount (major units) and upside_percentage are read too.

parameters.name: pool_share_percent
parameters.description: This act's share of the pool payout when the budget's pool is in pool mode (Opendate: pool_percentage); null = an equal part of what the explicit shares leave.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Who answers: { name, email, company, phone }. The email is where the offer is sent.

parameters.name: boilerplate
parameters.description: Conditions shown to the agent and on the PDF, up to 10,000 characters.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Internal, up to 4,000 characters. Never shown to the agent.

parameters.name: expires_at
parameters.description: After this a sent offer reads as expired and can no longer be answered.

parameters.name: budget_id
parameters.description: Join this budget (a lineup sharing one budget; Opendate: v3_budget_id). On a change, drafts only. Left out on create: a new budget.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: A new budget for this offer (ignored with budget_id).
